Class FieldReplicationService

public without sharing class FieldReplicationService

Service class for replicating field values between parent and child SObject records. Supports bidirectional field replication (parent-to-child and child-from-parent) using metadata-driven configuration from ReplicationSettings__mdt. Handles direct field mapping and lookup field traversal for related object data.

Methods

public static List<SObject> copyRecords(
  String settingsName,
  Set<Id> recordIds
)

Creates new target SObject records by copying field values from source records using metadata-driven field mappings. Supports direct field copying and external ID-based lookup references for related records. Does not perform DML; returns the created records for caller to insert.

Parameters:
    settingsName – String: The developer name of the ReplicationSettings__mdt record defining the copy configuration
    recordIds – Set<Id>: Set of source parent record IDs to copy from

Returns:
    SObject[]: Array of new child records with mapped field values, ready for insert/upsert

Since:
    12/20/2025

public static void replicateChildFromParent(
  String settingsName,
  List<SObject> parentRecords
)

Replicates field values from parent records to the current child records. Queries parent records based on lookup field values, applies field mappings (including traversal of related objects), and updates the child records. Updates are only performed if not in trigger context.

Parameters:
    settingsName – String: The developer name of the ReplicationSettings__mdt record
    parentRecords – SObject[]: Array of child records that reference parent records via lookup field

public static void replicateParentToChild(
  String settingsName,
  List<SObject> childRecords
)

Replicates field values from parent records to all their related child records. Queries parent records along with their child records via relationship, applies field mappings (including traversal of lookup fields), and updates all child records. Performs database update if child records exist.

Parameters:
    settingsName – String: The developer name of the ReplicationSettings__mdt record
    childRecords – SObject[]: Array of parent records whose child records will be updated

public static void triggerReplicateChildFromParent(String settingsName)

Trigger-context method to replicate field values from parent records to child records. Reads configuration from metadata and applies field mappings using Trigger.new as the source records.

Parameters:
    settingsName – String: The developer name of the ReplicationSettings__mdt record

public static void triggerReplicateParentToChild(String settingsName)

Trigger-context method to replicate field values from parent records to their child records. Reads configuration from metadata and applies field mappings using Trigger.new as the parent records.

Parameters:
    settingsName – String: The developer name of the ReplicationSettings__mdt record
